notes: Analytics: new 'Compare with' setting (previous 1 to 5 periods, remembered per device) and a comparison table with each key stat for this period, each earlier period, their average and the change. With more than one period the tiles compare against the average. Earlier periods now line up with the calendar (months with months, quarters with quarters, month-to-date with the same days of earlier months, a single day with the same weekday in earlier weeks).
